_doc: Bảng style nhạc nền cho gen_pack.py. Mỗi style: name (tên file <name>.mp3 trong thư viện), mood/use (mô tả cho người chọn), prompt (tiếng Anh — MusicGen hiểu mô tả tiếng Anh). Tất cả instrumental, dùng làm lớp nền dưới giọng đọc.

styles.name: broadcast-bed
styles.use: Bản tin, tổng hợp — mặc định an toàn.
styles.prompt: modern broadcast underscore, corporate electronic, 94 BPM, instrumental, clean polished mix, soft pulsing synth bass, warm pad, light electronic percussion and soft claps, gentle pluck arpeggio, neutral confident and subtly uplifting, unobtrusive background bed

styles.name: uplifting-intro
styles.use: Tin tốt, ra mắt, cột mốc.
styles.prompt: uplifting corporate intro, 95 BPM, instrumental, bright synth plucks, warm pad, soft piano accents, light percussion, hopeful neutral broadcast mood, clean modern

styles.name: minimal-tech
styles.use: Chủ đề công nghệ, dữ liệu.
styles.prompt: minimal tech bed, 92 BPM, instrumental, arpeggiated synth, subtle soft kick, airy pads, clean modern corporate, calm neutral, data driven feel

styles.name: cinematic-ambient
styles.use: Phân tích dài, chủ đề nghiêm túc.
styles.prompt: cinematic ambient underscore, 80 BPM, warm string pad, soft piano, subtle swells, calm serious documentary mood, instrumental, unobtrusive background bed

styles.name: lofi-chill
styles.prompt: lofi chillhop background, 85 BPM, mellow rhodes piano, soft clean drum beat, warm bass, relaxed neutral mood, instrumental, loopable

styles.name: energetic-drive
styles.prompt: energetic upbeat intro, 110 BPM, driving electronic, punchy claps, bright plucky synths, motivating positive mood, instrumental, clean

styles.name: inspiring-piano
styles.use: Câu chuyện con người, kết bài.
styles.prompt: inspiring corporate piano underscore, 90 BPM, gentle piano lead, warm strings, soft light percussion, hopeful emotional yet neutral, instrumental

styles.name: tech-pulse
styles.prompt: modern tech pulse bed, 100 BPM, pulsing analog synth bass, steady soft four on the floor kick, glassy plucks, futuristic clean, instrumental

styles.name: calm-corporate
styles.prompt: calm corporate background, 88 BPM, soft marimba and pluck, warm pad, light shaker percussion, professional gentle, unobtrusive, instrumental

styles.name: dynamic-newsroom
styles.prompt: dynamic newsroom underscore, 105 BPM, tense pulsing strings, electronic percussion, urgent but controlled broadcast mood, instrumental
